Container.Name: beannote
Container.Overview:
BeanNote is a personal coffee journal and rating companion. Scan bags, rate beans, and keep brew notes in a mobile-first PWA.
Put appdata on a cache-only share. JWT_SECRET, ADMIN_EMAIL, and ADMIN_PASSWORD are required for a working Unraid install. Keep ENVIRONMENT=production and RESET_DB_ON_START=false.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: BeanNote web UI

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: SQLite, user photos, and catalog uploads. Prefer a cache-only share, not /mnt/user.

Config.Name: ENVIRONMENT
Config.Description: Must stay production on Unraid. local wipes the database on start.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Unraid nobody

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Unraid users

Config.Name: JWT Secret
Config.Description: Required. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. Shown in Edit so Unraid keeps it in the template.

Config.Name: Admin Email
Config.Description: Creates or promotes this account as admin on start. Shown in Edit so Unraid keeps it in the template.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: At least 8 characters. Applied on every container start. Shown in Edit so Unraid keeps it in the template.

Config.Name: Gemini API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Enables bag OCR via Gemini. Tesseract remains the offline fallback.

Config.Name: Public Base URL
Config.Description: Public HTTPS origin, no trailing slash. Example: https://beannote.example.com. Required for Google/Apple OAuth.

Config.Name: Reset DB on start
Config.Description: Keep false. true is only for local test wipes.

Config.Name: Google Client ID
Config.Description: Optional Google OAuth client ID

Config.Name: Google Client Secret
Config.Description: Optional Google OAuth client secret

Config.Name: Apple Client ID
Config.Description: Optional Sign in with Apple Services ID

Config.Name: Apple Team ID
Config.Description: Optional Apple Team ID

Config.Name: Apple Key ID
Config.Description: Optional Apple Key ID

Config.Name: Apple Private Key
Config.Description: Optional Apple .p8 key. Paste as one line with \n for newlines.

Config.Name: Web Workers
Config.Description: Keep 1 on Unraid/SQLite

Config.Name: Job Workers
Config.Description: 0 keeps the scan worker inside the web process

Config.Name: OCR Max Concurrent
Config.Description: Max simultaneous Gemini/OCR jobs

Config.Name: Scan Rate Per Minute
Config.Description: Bag scan rate limit

Config.Name: Enrich Rate Per Minute
Config.Description: Bean enrich rate limit

Config.Name: MobilePay URL
Config.Description: https:// support link. Empty hides the sidebar Support card.

Config.Name: Buy Me a Coffee URL
Config.Description: https:// support link. Empty hides the sidebar Support card.
